title: The Best Lutron Caseta Occupancy Sensors
subtitle: Caseta motion sensors that turn your Lutron lights on and off, ranked.
intro: We pulled Lutron's Caseta occupancy and vacancy sensors on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features.
systems_note: Through a Lutron Smart Bridge. The sensors also pair straight to Caseta dimmers and switches without the bridge.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: Turns Caseta lights on and off automatically, with a 10-year battery and 959 reviews.

awards.label: Best for Bedrooms
awards.why: Vacancy mode: you switch lights on, it turns them off when you leave.

products.verdict: Walk in and the lights come on; leave and they go off.
pros: Controls any number of Caseta devices
cons: App features need the Smart Bridge
products.name: Lutron Caseta Smart Lighting Auto On/Off Wireless Occupancy Motion Sensor

products.model: Caseta Vacancy Sensor (manual on, auto off)
products.verdict: Only turns lights off, so nobody gets blinded at night.
pros: Same sensing as the occupancy model
products.name: Lutron Caseta Smart Lighting Manual On, Auto Off Wireless Vacancy Sensor

buyers_guide.a: Occupancy mode turns lights on when you walk in and off when you leave. Vacancy mode only turns them off, so you switch them on yourself, which suits bedrooms.

buyers_guide.q: Does it work without the bridge?
buyers_guide.a: It pairs straight to Caseta dimmers and switches without a bridge. With the bridge you can use it in the Lutron app and other automations.

buyers_guide.q: How long do the batteries last?
buyers_guide.a: Most battery sensors on these lists are rated for one to three years, depending on how often they report. Low-power radios like Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread last much longer than Wi-Fi.
